# LibrePods — distributables

Ready-to-install builds, grouped per operating system.

| OS | Folder | Contents |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 🪟 **Windows** | [`windows/`](windows/) | `librepods.exe` (full app), `librepods-tray.exe` (tray), the `LibrePodsAAP` driver, and a one-shot `install.ps1` |
| 🐧 Linux | — | build from `../app` (`cargo build --release`); packaging TBD |

See each folder's `README.md` for install steps.
